title: The text discusses the global food crises that have escalated over the past two years, leading to widespread protests and strikes in various countries. People in nations like Peru, Mexico, Indonesia, Haiti, and Burkina Faso have taken to the streets to demand price controls on food as millions face hunger and hardship. The situation highlights the urgent need for action to address food security and the struggles faced by communities worldwide.
